build-qualification-timing-harness.py.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the declared timing transport; no plugin invocation or estimation."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shlex
import subprocess

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--source', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
source = a.source.resolve(strict=True)
output = a.output.resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
assert not any(output.iterdir()), 'refuse to overwrite any harness artifact'
system = platform.system()
assert system in ('Darwin', 'Linux')
binary = output / 'actual_plugin_loader_test'
flags = ['-std=c11', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Wpedantic', '-Wconversion',
         '-Wshadow', '-Wstrict-prototypes', '-Wmissing-prototypes', '-Werror',
         '-D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L', '-DREPLAY_TIMING',
         '-DSYSTEM=' + ('APPLEMAC' if system == 'Darwin' else 'OPUNIX'),
         '-DREPLAY_MAX_ROWS=1000000', '-DREPLAY_MAX_CELLS=10000000ULL',
         '-I' + str(source / 'plugin')]
cc = os.environ.get('CC', 'cc')
main = str(source / 'tests/mock_spi/actual_plugin_loader_test.c')
dependencies = subprocess.check_output([cc, *flags, '-MM', main], text=True, timeout=60)
names = shlex.split(dependencies.replace('\\\n', ' ').split(':', 1)[1])
paths = sorted({Path(name).resolve(strict=True) for name in names})
external = [path for path in paths if not path.is_relative_to(source)]
assert all(system == 'Darwin' and path.name == 'SDKSettings.json' and
           str(path).startswith('/Applications/Xcode.app/') for path in external)
paths = [path for path in paths if path.is_relative_to(source)]
assert source / 'tests/mock_spi/replay.h' in paths
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
hashes = {str(path.relative_to(source)): sha(path) for path in paths}
command = [cc, *flags, main, '-lc' if system == 'Darwin' else '-ldl', '-o', str(binary)]
with (output / 'build.log').open('xb') as log:
    subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=120)
macros = subprocess.check_output([cc, *flags, '-dM', '-E', main], text=True, timeout=60)
expected = {'REPLAY_TIMING': '1', 'REPLAY_MAX_ROWS': '1000000',
            'REPLAY_MAX_CELLS': '10000000ULL', '_POSIX_C_SOURCE': '200809L'}
observed = {line.split()[1]: ' '.join(line.split()[2:]) for line in macros.splitlines()
            if len(line.split()) >= 3 and line.split()[1] in expected}
assert observed == expected, observed
assert hashes == {str(path.relative_to(source)): sha(path) for path in paths}
record = {'schema': 1, 'platform': system, 'native_calls': 0,
          'max_rows': 1000000, 'max_cells': 10000000, 'sha256': sha(binary),
          'source_sha256': hashes, 'preprocessor_macros': observed,
          'sdk_sha256': {path.name: sha(path) for path in external},
          'compiler': subprocess.check_output([cc, '--version'], text=True, timeout=10),
          'command': [arg.replace(str(source), '<repo>').replace(str(output), '<output>')
                      for arg in command]}
(output / 'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'sha256': record['sha256'], 'source_files': len(hashes),
                  'native_calls': 0, 'preprocessor_macros': observed}))

"""Retain the prospective 1+79 transport repair; no native invocation."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=task.parents[2]
remote='<task>'
out=repo/'bench/results/ownership-qualification-transport-repair-freeze-20261023.json'
assert not out.exists()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def portable(v):
    if isinstance(v,str):return v.replace(str(task),'<task>').replace(str(repo),'<repository>').replace(remote,'<task>')
    if isinstance(v,list):return [portable(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {portable(k):portable(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    return v
def doc(p):return dict(sha256=sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,content=read(p))
def account(p,job,wall):
    fields={k:v.strip() for k,v in (line.split(None,1) for line in p.read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split(None,1))==2)}
    assert fields['failed']==fields['exit_status']=='0' and fields['jobnumber']==str(job)
    assert fields['slots']=='4' and fields['taskid']=='undefined' and 0<float(fields['ru_wallclock'])<=wall
    return dict(raw_sha256=sha(p),fields=fields)

platforms={}
for platform,tag in (('Darwin','macos'),('Linux','linux')):
    folder=task/'sources/qualification-transport-repair/target/tmp/ownership-cells' if platform=='Darwin' else task/'linux-qualification/transport-repair'
    q=folder/f'qualification-{platform}.json';d=folder/f'qualification-diagnostics-{platform}.json'
    plan=read(q);diagnostic=read(d);repair=diagnostic['transport_repair']
    assert diagnostic['qualification_sha256']==sha(q) and len(diagnostic['schedule'])==diagnostic['native_calls']==80
    assert (repair['reused_calls'],repair['new_calls'],repair['total_calls'])==(1,79,80)
    assert repair['charged_seconds']==(2 if platform=='Darwin' else 20)
    assert len(plan['cases'])==29 and set(plan['artifacts'])=={'original','incumbent','candidate'}
    assert plan['artifacts']['candidate']['request']=='cells_deferred_both'
    build=task/f'harness-qualification-timing-{tag}/build.json'
    assert read(build)['sha256']==plan['files'][plan['harness']]
    platforms[platform]=dict(qualification=doc(q),diagnostics=doc(d),harness_build=doc(build))
failed=repo/'bench/results/ownership-qualification-diagnostic-transport-failure-20261023.json'
original=repo/'bench/results/ownership-cells-qualification-freeze-20261023.json'
prefix=task/'diagnostic-transport-prefix-Darwin/verification.json'
assert read(prefix)['native_calls']==0 and read(prefix)['independent_oracle']=='passed'
checks=doc(task/'diagnostic-transport-source-check.json')
assert checks['content']['exit_code']==0 and checks['content']['source_unchanged_after']
assert '200 runtime modules, 58 artifact inputs' in (task/'diagnostic-transport-production-check.log').read_text()
tests=[]
for p in sorted(task.glob('diagnostic-transport-tests-*.log')):
    passed=p.read_text().rstrip().endswith('OK')
    tests.append(dict(name=p.name,sha256=sha(p),passed=passed,
                      diagnosis=None if passed else 'Test source dictionary syntax error; corrected before execution of positive tests.'))
assert len(tests)==5 and not tests[0]['passed'] and all(t['passed'] for t in tests[1:])
helpers={}
for name in ('build-qualification-timing-harness.py','build-qualification-timing-harness-linux.sh',
             'snapshot-qualification-transport-repair.py','freeze-qualification-transport-linux.sh',
             'diagnose-qualification-transport-linux.sh','prove-qualification-transport-linux.sh',
             'run-qualification-transport-macos.py',
             'retain-qualification-transport-freeze.py'):
    p=task/name;helpers[name]=dict(sha256=sha(p),source=p.read_text())
freeze_log=task/'linux-qualification/transport-repair/freeze-job.log'
assert freeze_log.read_text().splitlines().count('QUALIFICATION_TRANSPORT_FREEZE_COMPLETE')==1
build_log=task/'harness-qualification-timing-linux/job.log'
assert build_log.read_text().splitlines().count('QUALIFICATION_TIMING_HARNESS_COMPLETE')==1
record=dict(schema=1,kind='ownership-qualification-transport-repair-freeze',date='2026-10-23',
    prior_records=[dict(path=p.name,sha256=sha(p)) for p in (original,failed)],
    execution=doc(task/'qualification-transport-repair-source.json'),platforms=platforms,
    application_budget=dict(Darwin=dict(original=2400,charged=2,remaining=2398),
                            Linux=dict(original=2400,charged=20,remaining=2380)),
    linux_reservation=dict(host='scc-uf3.scc.bu.edu',slots=28,pe='mpi_28_tasks_per_node_u',mem_per_core='3G',
                          original_scheduler_s=2700,charged_scheduler_s=34,remaining_scheduler_s=2666),
    scope='Only the missing timing/serialization compile definitions and reviewed diagnostic prefix continuation. Same native artifacts, inputs, references, 80-call schedules, tolerances, solver policy and final timing budgets.',
    mac_prefix_validation=doc(prefix),
    linux_prefix_validation='Required inside the repaired runner before any new native invocation; not yet executed at this freeze.',
    timer_exception='The original first incumbent call alone retains its complete-process elapsed upper bound. Native timer and per-call RSS remain unavailable; this is never a performance observation. All79 new calls require normal native timers.',
    tests=tests,source_check=checks,production_identity=dict(log_sha256=sha(task/'diagnostic-transport-production-check.log'),runtime_modules=200,artifact_inputs=58,unchanged=True),
    independent_review='High-effort implementation plus bounded Astra review of final source and wrappers; no material blocker. No scientific or performance gate waived.',
    linux_harness_build=dict(accounting=account(task/'harness-qualification-timing-linux/accounting.txt',8265980,300),log_sha256=sha(build_log),native_calls=0),
    linux_freeze=dict(accounting=account(task/'linux-qualification/transport-repair/freeze-accounting.txt',8266037,900),log_sha256=sha(freeze_log),native_calls=0),
    setup_failure=dict(operation='Local repair manifest CLI',failure='Used --config instead of the positional config argument; parser exited2 before writing a manifest or invoking native code.',
                       log_sha256=sha(task/'qualification-transport-freeze-Darwin.log'),repair='Corrected the argument before remote submission; identical config then froze successfully.',
                       successful_log_sha256=sha(task/'qualification-transport-freeze-Darwin-repair.log'),native_calls=0),
    native_calls_at_freeze=dict(previous_incumbent_per_platform=1,new_continuation_per_platform=0,candidate_per_platform=0,final_timing_per_platform=0),
    remaining_prerequisites=['All80 diagnostic slots including exact reuse must pass on both platforms, with distinct old/new observer cohorts and complete Linux accounting.',
                            'The unchanged final58-cell timing qualification and exact hidden/public/public-repeat integration remain required before branch activation.'],
    helpers=helpers,qualification_passed=False,activation_qualified=False)
encoded=(json.dumps(portable(record),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
assert len(encoded)<1000000 and not any(b'/'+x in encoded for x in (b'Users/',b'projectnb/',b'home/johannes'))
with out.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(encoded)
print(json.dumps(dict(bytes=len(encoded),sha256=sha(out))))

"""Freeze current qualification tooling over the preserved native source archive."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,tarfile

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=task.parents[2]
base=json.loads((task/'deferred-source.json').read_text())
out=task/'sources/qualification-transport-repair';archive=task/'qualification-transport-repair-source.tar'
record_path=task/'qualification-transport-repair-source.json'
assert not any(p.exists() for p in (out,archive,record_path))
assert base['fereg']=='c78f5c9c6a9e703eb45087630698a8d87cfdb923'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','bench'],cwd=repo,text=True).splitlines()
tools={n for n in tracked if not n.startswith('bench/results/') and n.endswith(('.py','.sh'))}
names=sorted(set(base['files'])|tools);files={};changes={}
for name in names:
    old=task/'sources/deferred'/name
    if name in base['files']:
        assert hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==base['files'][name],name
    src=repo/name if name in tools else old
    target=out/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src,target);files[name]=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if files[name]!=base['files'].get(name):
        assert name in tools
        changes[name]=dict(before=base['files'].get(name),after=files[name])
with tarfile.open(archive,'x') as tar:
    for name in names:tar.add(out/name,arcname=name,recursive=False)
record=dict(fereg=base['fereg'],cmg=base['cmg'],
    execution_revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),
    native_source_archive_sha256=base['archive_sha256'],files=files,tooling_amendment=changes,
    archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    previous_execution_archive_sha256=json.loads((task/'qualification-execution-source.json').read_text())['archive_sha256'],
    scope='Bounded 1+79 diagnostic transport repair. Current maintained benchmark tooling over the unchanged native c78 archive; actual native source/build records remain separate and immutable. No native build or estimation performed.')
with record_path.open('x') as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True);stream.write('\n')
print('QUALIFICATION_EXECUTION_FROZEN',record['execution_revision'],record['archive_sha256'],len(files),sorted(changes))

independent_review: High-effort implementation plus bounded Astra review of final source and wrappers; no material blocker. No scientific or performance gate waived.
linux_prefix_validation: Required inside the repaired runner before any new native invocation; not yet executed at this freeze.

ownership_transport.basis: Bound 64-bit FFI exact argv/String reservations; raw caps checked before normalization. Real ownership storage changes are retained.
